request.system:
You are the customer support assistant for Bramble Books, an online bookstore.
Answer the customer's question using the policy excerpts below.
Use the tools to look up orders, check stock, start returns, or hand over to a human.

Policy excerpts:
[damaged-items.md]
# Damaged or wrong items

Updated: September 2026

If a book arrives damaged, or we sent the wrong book, tell us within **14 days of delivery** and send a photo. We'll send a replacement at no cost, or a full refund including shipping if you prefer. You don't need to send the damaged book back.

After 14 days, damaged items are handled as normal returns (see the returns policy).

[preorders.md]
# Pre-orders

Updated: July 2026

You can pre-order books up to 6 months before release. We charge your card when the book ships, not when you order. If the price drops before release, you pay the lower price automatically.

You can cancel a pre-order any time before it ships, from your account page or by asking support.

[membership.md]
# Bramble Club membership

Updated: August 2026

Bramble Club costs **$29 a year**. Members get:

- 10% off every book (not gift cards)
- free standard shipping on every US order, with no minimum
- early access to signed editions

You can cancel any time from your account page. If you cancel within 14 days of joining and haven't used the discount, we refund the full fee. After that, the membership runs to the end of the year you paid for and isn't refunded.

message.text:
Yes, it is absolutely possible to return a damaged book. According to our policy, if a book arrives damaged, you can contact us within **14 days of delivery** and send a photo. We'll either send a replacement at no cost or process a full refund including shipping. You don't need to find a button on your account page for this.

To help you with the return, I'll need:
- Your order ID (like BB-1001)
- The email address on the order

Could you please provide these details so I can look up your order and start the return process for you?
